mc: Mc is one million periods per second.
Mc means the same as megahertz or MHz or megacycle per second.
mcalester: McAlester is a town in southeastern Oklahoma.
mcallen: McAllen is a town in southern Texas on the Rio Grande.
mcardle's disease: McArdle's disease is an inherited disease in which abnormal amounts of glycogen accumulate in skeletal muscle.
mcburney's point: McBurney's point is a point one third of the way along a line drawn from the hip to the umbilicus.
mccarthy: McCarthy is United States satirical novelist and literary critic.
McCarthy can also mean United States politician who unscrupulously accused many citizens of being Communists.
McCarthy means the same as Mary McCarthy or Mary Therese McCarthy or Joseph McCarthy.
mccarthyism: McCarthyism is unscrupulously accusing people of disloyalty.
mccartney: McCartney is English rock star and bass guitarist and songwriter who with John Lennon wrote most of the music for the Beatles.
McCartney means the same as Paul McCartney or Sir James Paul McCartney.
mccauley: McCauley is heroine of the American Revolution who carried water to soldiers during the Battle of Monmouth Court House and took over her husband's gun when he was overcome by heat.
McCauley means the same as Mary McCauley or Mary Ludwig Hays McCauley or Molly Pitcher.
mccormick: McCormick is United States inventor and manufacturer of a mechanical harvester.
McCormick can also mean United States operatic tenor.
McCormick means the same as Cyrus McCormick or Cyrus Hall McCormick or John McCormick.
mccullers: McCullers means the same as Carson McCullers or Carson Smith McCullers.
mcg: A mcg is one millionth gram.
Mcg means the same as microgram.
mcgraw: McGraw is United States baseball player and manager.
McGraw means the same as John McGraw or John Joseph McGraw.
mcguffey: McGuffey is United States educator who compiled the McGuffey Eclectic Readers.
McGuffey means the same as William Holmes McGuffey.
mcguffey eclectic readers: McGuffey Eclectic Readers is readers that combined lessons in reading with moralistic messages.
mcguffin: McGuffin is a plot element that catches the viewers' attention or drives the plot.
For example: "The McGuffin was a key element of Alfred Hitchcock's films."
McGuffin means the same as MacGuffin.
mcia: MCIA is an agency of the United States Marine Corps that provides responsive and broad intelligence support for the worldwide Marine Corps organization.
MCIA means the same as Marine Corps Intelligence Activity.
mcintosh: McIntosh is early-ripening apple popular in the northeastern United States.
mckim: McKim is United States neoclassical architect.
McKim means the same as Charles Follen McKim.
mckinley: McKinley is 25th President of the United States.
McKinley can also mean a mountain in south central Alaska.
McKinley means the same as William McKinley or President McKinley or Mount McKinley.
mcluhan: McLuhan is Canadian writer noted for his analyses of the mass media.
McLuhan means the same as Marshall McLuhan or Herbert Marshall McLuhan.
mcmaster: McMaster is United States historian who wrote a nine volume history of the people of the United States.
McMaster means the same as John Bach McMaster.
mcpherson: McPherson is United States evangelist noted for her extravagant religious services.
McPherson means the same as Aimee Semple McPherson.
